comparison.objective: Candidate removes a fan; record assembles an open drive-chain joint.
comparison.physical_skill: Latch-and-lift versus aligning chain ends and sliding a forked retaining plate under two pin heads.
comparison.success_condition: Fan outside bay without damage versus both pin stems at closed slot ends, joint retained in cradle, and hands released.
comparison.reason: The record tests multi-part joint assembly and lateral keyed insertion, not module extraction.
